product_results.title: Schylling NeeDoh Squishmas Advent Calendar (Pack of 1)
product_results.description: Celebrate the magic of the season with the Schylling NeeDoh Squishmas Advent Calendar. This festive countdown features 24 mini NeeDoh squish toys hidden behind numbered doors, turning each December day into a colorful sensory surprise. From satisfying squishes to playful textures, every teenie toy offers a delightful tactile experience that keeps kids entertained while building excitement for Christmas morning. Perfect for holiday traditions, this advent calendar transforms the classic countdown into a daily celebration filled with vibrant color and squeezable joy.

about_item: Countdown with a NeeDoh Surprise Every Day! – Make the holiday season extra exciting with 24 days of squishy sensory fun as kids reveal a new delight behind each door.
Pop Open Each Door for a Mini Sensory Sensation – Discover vibrant, colorful NeeDoh teenie toys that bring satisfying squeezes, stretches, and smiles with every reveal.
Get Groovy with Unique Teeny Toys – Enjoy a playful mix of shapes, textures, and tactile experiences designed to keep little hands busy and entertained all season long.

One Advent Calendar Packed with 24 Toys – Includes twenty-four individual mini NeeDoh toys per pack, each approximately 1.25” tall—perfectly sized for stocking stuffers, classroom rewards, or festive surprises.
Perfect for Ages 3+ – A safe, screen-free holiday activity that builds anticipation, encourages sensory exploration, and adds a playful twist to traditional Christmas countdowns.
